Anything Muffins
By: Kitch-N-Chik
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 5:29pm

Ingredients




2 lrgs Eggs or equivalent substitute
1 cup Brown sugar (up to 1)
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 cup Applesauce
2 cups Flour
1 teaspoon Baking powder
1 teaspoon Salt
FRUIT COMBINATION (PICK ONE):
1 cup Mashed banana
1 cup Low sugar marmalade
1 cup Mashed banana
1 cup Low sugar strawberry preserves
1 cup Fresh blueberries
1 cup Chopped granny smith apples
1 cup Mashed banana
1 cup Mandarin orange pieces, mashed

Preparation

1 (Make up your own, just make sure the is some fluid in the ingredients here) 2 Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Mix dry ingredients thoroughly, set aside. Mix wet ingredients in a large bowl, add dry ingredients, mix until just blended, add fruit. Bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of muffin comes out clean.
